title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
I had some VISA delays ongoing and had to wait for the VISA to arrive until the 2nd week of classes started. This made me fall behind a little bit and I had to do some catching up to do. I arrived on Friday 11th Sep in Vancouver and immediately started with the assignments. This resulted in my asssignment for 521 getting submitted with a delay.

title: Raghav Haralalka
text: Hi, I am a 26 year old student from Kolkata, India. I completed my Bachelors from SRM University, Chennai in 2023 with 9.48/10 GPA and worked at ZS Associates Pune as Business Technology Solutions Associate/Associate Consultant working in the Data Engineering field for 3 years before deciding to join the MDS program at UBC Vancouver. My hobbies include going on a drive, watching sports/movies and playing sports such as table tennis, lawn tennis and badminton among others. My goal from the MDS course is to create impact especially in the field of sports where the amount of data coming in is already very huge and has potential to transform all of them.
